title: Teaching Material Package Manifest
description: Per EO-S1.1-003 v1.0. Package-level bookkeeping, distinct from metadata.json's subject-matter fields. 'status' values and 'analysisEngine' being a fixed single value are Claude's own judgment calls — this EO names the manifest's fields but not their exact allowed values; flagged in README.md rather than decided silently.

packageVersion.description: Mirrors metadata.json's own version — starts "1", increments on each Existing Material update

repositoryVersion.description: Which EO-S1.1-00x schema generation this package was built against, e.g. "EO-S1.1-003"

analysisEngine.description: Per every EO in this track's 'Role: Claude（Teaching Material Analysis Engine）' and 'no AI API' constraint, the only value this can honestly be today

status.description: draft: Claude is still analyzing. pending_review: at least one question has needsReview=true (OCR confidence < 0.90) — per the OCR Rule, this package is NOT yet the official Repository entry until resolved. complete: every question resolved, no outstanding review flags.

archived.description: Sprint AI-115 AI-115-01: optional, defaults to absent/false. The only real signal MaterialLifecycle.js's resolveStage() uses for the ARCHIVED stage — never inferred from age/usage, only this explicit, human/Claude-set flag.
